podcast.title: Prince Charles's Visit to a Ska Museum (2021)
podcast.body: Prince Charles demonstrated an unexpected interest in two-tone ska by visiting a ska museum in Coventry in 2021. His visit revealed his appreciation for the genre. "He even paid a visit to a ska museum in Coventry this year."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: The Selecter's Origins
podcast.body: The Selecter is identified as one of the "original two-tone scabans from Coventry England," featuring a mixed-race and mixed-gender lineup. "Starting the program in 1979 with the selector, one of the original two-tone scabans from Coventry England."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
